classified->LOST: one muffalo, answers to Gerald. Reward paid in pemmican.
classified->FOR SALE: charge rifle, one careful owner, minor scorch marks. No questions.
classified->WANTED: doctor with steady hands and fewer than three mental breaks a season.
classified->HATS repaired, re-made, or taken from the fallen. Discretion assured.
classified->BOOMALOPE WRANGLER needed. Fire insurance not provided.
classified->THRUMBO sighted north of the river. Do not approach. Do admire from a distance.
classified->INSECT JELLY, fresh from the hive. Freshness not guaranteed. No refunds.
classified->LEARN TO COOK! Our graduates' food poisoning rate is now under ten percent.
classified->ANCIENT DANGER TOURS. Guide not included (guide was eaten).
classified->FOUND: one bionic arm, still waving. Collect from the town well.
classified->ROOM TO LET. Pleasant, impressive, only slightly haunted by the previous tenant.
classified->PSYCHITE TEA for medicinal purposes only. Very medicinal. Ask for "the usual".
classified->SEEKING MATCH: lonely hermit, likes long walks to nowhere. No cannibals.
classified->MECHANOID PARTS bought and sold. Do not ask where they came from. Do not turn them on.
classified->ALPACA WOOL, finest on the rim. Alpacas not for sale. Alpacas know what they did.
classified->TOXIC FALLOUT? Stay indoors and read the Courier. Twice.
classified->COMMS CONSOLE REPAIRS. We also fix your relations with the Empire (results not guaranteed).
classified->BEER! Brewed in a real barrel by a real colonist with a real Brewing skill of at least 3.
classified->FUNERAL SERVICES. Sarcophagus, grave or "the usual spot behind the pig pen".
classified->PRISONER WORK RELEASE: experienced cook, recruitable with patience. Do not let near knives.
classified->WILL TRADE: two pet rats for anything that is not another pet rat.
classified->CARAVAN GUARDS for hire. Musket-trained. Have never once run away. Mostly.
classified->SMOKELEAF JOINTS for "relaxation". Side effects include laziness and saying "far out".
classified->MISSING: our last editor. If found, remind him the paper is due.
classified->CRYPTOSLEEP PODS, lightly used. Occupants removed. Probably.
classified->PUBLIC NOTICE: the eclipse is not a sign. The volcanic winter, however, may be.
classified->GOODWILL GIFTS wrapped while you wait. Silver preferred. Organs frowned upon.
